import html from typing import List # Example template – adjust the placeholder names as needed. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

by {author}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a user's forum post. Parameters ---------- author : str The name of the user who wrote the post. title : str The title of the post. body : str The main content of the post. post_tags : list[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized HTML of the post. """ # Escape all user-controllable input to mitigate XSS (CWE-79) safe_author = html.escape(author, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Build the tags HTML tag_spans = [] for tag in post_tags: safe_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) tag_spans.append(f"{safe_tag}") tags_html = " ".join(tag_spans) # Format the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, author=safe_author, body=safe_body, tags=tags_html )
